# How many should I make per batch so changeovers and stock cost me the least?

> Free batch size calculator for candle, soap, sauce, print and baked-goods makers: enter setup cost, holding cost and shelf life, and get the run size with the lowest yearly cost, with pack-size and limited-hours handling. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
